text:
Korea added 139,000 jobs in October from a year earlier, government data showed Wednesday, with job growth exceeding the 100,000 mark for the fourth consecutive month.
The number of employed people came to 29.17 million in October, compared with 29.04 million a year earlier, according to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics.
Job growth turned positive in June after declining by 40,000 in May, the first drop in 17 months.
The country's jobless rate came to 2 percent last month, down 0.2 percentage point from a year earlier.
The number of unemployed people totaled 602,000 in October, down 56,000 from the same month in 2025.
The employment rate for people aged 15 to 64 came to 70.4 percent, up 0.3 percentage point from a year earlier.
The figure for those aged 15 to 29, on the other hand, fell 1.7 percentage points to 42.9 percent.
